title: Semivan on a non-state intelligence network and the 2016 leaks

tellings.quote: According to Semivan, a non-state intelligence network is responsible for the leaking of these emails

plain: The emails leaked in 2016, a story that touches Hillary Clinton, Donald Trump and Mike Pompeo, were leaked by an intelligence network that belongs to no government, according to a man named Jim Semivan. A researcher named Jason Simosa passes this on to Michels without naming a source: 'According to Semivan, a non-state intelligence network is responsible for the leaking of these emails.' If true, it would mean a private spy network outside any state helped shape that year's events.
